resources.string: Sign in to Minecraft with LeviLauncher
Use the active account in Minecraft. Offline play stays available.
Accounts stay saved. Turn this on to use the active account in Minecraft.
Keep your Xbox profiles here and choose which one Minecraft uses.
Remove %1$s from LeviLauncher? This does not delete your Microsoft account.
Offline: using the saved account. Online features need an internet connection.
Offline: launching Minecraft without online sign-in. Your saved accounts are unchanged.
Choose how to add your Microsoft / Xbox profile.
Use Microsoft’s sign-in page inside LeviLauncher.
Use your browser, or enter the code on another device.
Open Microsoft’s page and confirm the code. You can also use the address on another device.
Sign-in could not finish. Try again or use the other sign-in method.
Sign-in timed out. Check your connection or request a new code.
A secure connection to Microsoft could not be verified. Check your connection and device time.
Xbox could not sign in this account. Check its Xbox profile, age, family and privacy settings.
The sign-in session or code expired. Start a new sign-in.
Microsoft or Xbox denied this sign-in. Try again with an eligible account.
Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
Microsoft or Xbox is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
Microsoft could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
